claims.text: model_revision is pinned, so this index_id differs from the one `daedalus context --latent` searches (that reader resolves a spec with model_revision=None). The latent half will report index_unavailable against this index.
claims.why: The claim references behavior of `daedalus context --latent` which is not in this chunk.

claims.text: The recorded content_hash covers the journal prefix below the watermark; if that prefix no longer reproduces, the index was derived from a history this file no longer has.
claims.why: The code computes a prefix hasher and compares its hexdigest against watermark.content_hash; mismatch leads to 'journal_forked' report.

claims.text: Stop here. Everything below ``watermark_position`` is committed and recorded; this batch is not, and the watermark must not claim otherwise.
claims.why: When ingest fails, code breaks out of loop without updating watermark_position further, and later returns report with watermark_position unchanged.

claims.text: Read from the index, not defaulted: a dry run reporting '0 projections' against an index holding thousands reads as a broken index rather than as an unasked question.
claims.why: The claim references index status check not in this chunk; dry_run uses len(projected_hashes) but that is from earlier query.
